description_en: Retrieves the quality score of an image
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-image-quality --project immimagetest --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/qualitytest.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetImageQuality

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri
